issue.title: New lightweight, stub-only mocks for scenarios where high performance is needed
issue.body:
It is possible to create "stub-only" mocks that don't track invocations and hence might be useful for scenarios where low memory footprint / high speed is desired.

``` java
Foo lightweight = mock(Foo.class, withSettings().stubOnly());
```

For more information please see: https://code.google.com/p/mockito/issues/detail?id=84
